description.narrative: The Project involves construction of a new road section of the E-60 highway located in Imereti Region of central Georgia. Section F4 forms the Shoropani-Argveta portion of the Khevi-Ubisa-Shorapani-Argveta section of the E-60.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3861: 75% of contracts awarded and 71% disbursed as of 20 Jun 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: As of 31 December 2023, estimated progress of executed works for the Shorapani-Argveta Section (F4) is about 79%.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Aug 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53178/53178-001-apfs-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental Impact Assessments | Oct 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53178/53178-001-eia-en_11.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Jun 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53178/53178-001-rp-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jan 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53178/53178-001-smr-en_10.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1. Works are ongoing on bridges, tunnels, and highways. With the current pace of progress, completion of works is expected by mid-2024.
2. Consultants for road safety awareness and entrepreneurship and livelihood development training have been recruited and activities are ongoing.
3a. All deliverables under the 38 Portable Scales contract have been completed, goods were delivered on site, and training conducted for installation and commissioning of the goods.
3b. Procurement of weigh-in-motion equipment is expected to commence in Q2 2024.
4. PBM component is proposed to be cancelled as the government considers it pre-mature to implement at the present time.
